header: The year-end at the till, in twelve points
lead: What has to be done before 31 December, what your accountant actually asks for, and what you can safely leave alone. Twelve pages, made to be printed and ticked off.
note: The file sits behind the link with no form in front of it. If you would like to hear from us anyway, that is what the Kassenbrief is for.
